tasks.title: Launch redesigned site
tasks.description: Plan and execute the website launch for Harbor & Pine Coffee, targeting November 20, 2026, with November 27, 2026 as the hard latest acceptable launch date (before Black Friday).
criteria: Launch date is set to 2026-11-20 in the project plan
Site is live by 2026-11-27 at the latest

tasks.title: Create first-round page mockups
tasks.description: Produce first-round design mockups for the homepage, menu page, and shop page and deliver them to Sam Becker.
criteria: Homepage mockup delivered
Menu page mockup delivered
Shop page mockup delivered

tasks.title: Send edited brand photos to designer
tasks.description: Provide Luis Ortega with the edited (not raw) new brand photos for use in the website design.
criteria: Edited photo files are shared with Luis Ortega
Raw files are not sent as the primary deliverable

tasks.title: Test migrate subscription product
tasks.description: Run a test migration of the monthly bean box subscription product into a staging Shopify store to confirm it migrates cleanly, then report findings back to the team.
criteria: Staging test migration is completed for the subscription product
Migration risks/issues and recommended approach are documented and shared

tasks.title: Transfer domain account access
tasks.description: Track down the domain login currently held by the old agency and transfer the domain into Harbor & Pine's control/account so DNS/email changes can be managed for launch.
criteria: Domain registrar access is obtained
Domain is transferred into Harbor & Pine's account/control

tasks.title: Draft product description template
tasks.description: Create a content template for product descriptions so the copywriter can fill in improved descriptions for the new shop pages upon return.
criteria: Template includes required fields/structure for product descriptions
Template is shared with relevant stakeholders for use by the copywriter

tasks.title: Notify copywriter about upcoming work
tasks.description: Give the copywriter (Dana) a heads-up about the product description work and the availability of the new template so she can start filling it in when she returns.
criteria: Copywriter is contacted with expectations and timing
Copywriter is directed to the template to use

tasks.title: Run accessibility palette contrast check
tasks.description: Perform a quick accessibility pass on the brand color palette (contrast checks) and incorporate any necessary adjustments/notes into the first mockup round.
criteria: Contrast issues are identified and documented
Recommended palette adjustments or usage guidance is reflected in the mockup work

tasks.title: Set up GA4 subscription conversion tracking
tasks.description: Implement GA4 analytics and configure conversion tracking specifically for subscription sign-ups (alongside Shopify analytics as needed). Marked low priority until the store migration is underway/complete.
criteria: GA4 property/tagging is set up for the site/store context
Subscription sign-ups are tracked as a conversion in GA4

tasks.title: Send meeting recap
tasks.description: Send a written recap of the kickoff meeting to all attendees summarizing scope, responsibilities, and key dates.
criteria: Recap is sent to all meeting participants
Recap includes key decisions, owners, and dates

tasks.title: Schedule weekly Thursday check-in
tasks.description: Set up a recurring weekly check-in meeting for Thursdays at 10:00.
criteria: Recurring meeting invite is created
All relevant participants are invited and meeting cadence is weekly Thursdays at 10:00
